items.headline: No local RAD measurement
items.detail: There is no Radiation Assessment Detector at Jezero. MSL RAD measured the surface environment at Gale Crater. Any Jezero value is an analogue or a model estimate.
items.display: Source: Gale RAD analogue / model. Not a local measurement.

items.headline: MEDA environmental time series
items.detail: MEDA measures pressure, air and surface temperature, wind, relative humidity, and dust/radiation context at the rover. Use the time series, not a single number.
items.display: Pressure: hundreds of pascals, sol-dependent; temperature well below 0 °C for much of the sol; wind and dust episodic.

items.headline: HiRISE DTM and traverse grades
items.detail: HiRISE DTMs are available at about 1 m/pixel for the landing area and delta. The rover's daily-position track has apparent grades up to about 32%.
items.display: DTM 1 m/px; local apparent grades up to ~32% along the rover track. Not a human trafficability model.

items.headline: No proven shallow ice at Jezero
items.detail: SWIM-style subsurface ice mapping focuses on mid-to-high latitudes. There is no verified shallow ice deposit at the Jezero rover site.
items.display: Ancient water is documented; present-day shallow ice is not.

items.headline: Design assumptions only
items.detail: Walking speed, EVA duration, carry capacity, suit mobility, and communications are design assumptions, not measured capabilities.
items.display: 1.5 km/h walking + 10 min per stop; 4 h EVA window. Adjustable; not NASA-validated.
